create_TensorMemoryPool: create a TensorMemoryPool instance with a given max_block_size and optional min_block_size for buddy allocation
allocate_memory_block: allocate a memory block of at least the requested size using the buddy allocation system
store_tensor_cuda: store a CUDA tensor into pinned host memory and return its address
load_tensor_to_device: load a tensor from pinned host memory back to a specified CUDA device
free_memory_block: free an allocated memory block and merge buddy blocks back into the free lists
